statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-3832 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-12): when GnuTLS before 3.8.13 validates a certificate against an OCSP response with several entries, it checks the revocation status of the first entry instead of the one matching the certificate, so a revoked certificate can be accepted. GnuTLS fixes it in 3.8.13 (https://www.gnutls.org/security-new.html), and Alpine lists it as fixed in gnutls 3.8.13-r0 for 3.23 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-3832). This owner is built from Alpine's gnutls package source for 3.23. Its published gnutls packages for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, x86_64 and aarch64, are 3.8.11-r0 and 3.8.12-r0, whose libgnutls library reports GnuTLS 3.8.11 and 3.8.12, and the current 3.8.13-r0, whose library reports GnuTLS 3.8.13. The range ends at 3.8.13-r0.

CVE-2026-3832 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-12): when GnuTLS before 3.8.13 validates a certificate against an OCSP response with several entries, it checks the revocation status of the first entry instead of the one matching the certificate, so a revoked certificate can be accepted. GnuTLS fixes it in 3.8.13 (https://www.gnutls.org/security-new.html), and Alpine lists it as fixed in gnutls 3.8.13-r0 for 3.23 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-3832). This owner is built from Alpine's gnutls package source for 3.23. Its published gnutls packages for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, x86_64 and aarch64, are 3.8.11-r0 and 3.8.12-r0, whose libgnutls library reports GnuTLS 3.8.11 and 3.8.12, and the current 3.8.13-r0, whose library reports GnuTLS 3.8.13. The range ends at 3.8.13-r0.

CVE-2026-3832: a logic error in how GnuTLS processes multi-record OCSP responses let a client with OCSP verification enabled accept a revoked server certificate. Upstream advisory GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-12 (https://www.gnutls.org/security-new.html#GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-12, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/issues/1812) was fixed in GnuTLS 3.8.13 by https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/731861b9de8dccaf7d3b0c1446833051e48670c2 ("cert-session: fix multi-entry OCSP revocation bypass"). The Debian tracker records that the flaw came in with GnuTLS 3.8.8 (https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/ae404fe8488dee424876b5963c00d7e041672415), so 3.8.9 is affected. Debian fixed it for trixie in gnutls28 3.8.9-3+deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-3832), which applies the GnuTLS 3.8.13 security patch set to 3.8.9 and carries that upstream commit. The only build of this owner currently published for Debian 13 is made from that Debian version, and the changelog shipped in its libgnutls30t64 package on amd64 and arm64 lists CVE-2026-3832 under 3.8.9-3+deb13u4. The range ends at that build, the lowest published version carrying the fix. Builds made from Debian's earlier 3.8.9-3+deb13u2 and 3.8.9-3+deb13u3 sources predate the fix and sort below it, so they are reported as affected.
